about_the_game:
Chinese Street Food Legend is a management and narrative game about night markets and the everyday lives of ordinary people.

You play as a street vendor, pushing your food stall through city alleys, grilling noodles on a sizzling iron plate, crafting not just food, but your own rhythm of life.

The Pace Between Fast and Slow

When cooking, everything happens in seconds: crack an egg, spread the sauce, flip the noodles, serve the plate.

The aroma fills the air, the steam rises, and you move with instinctive precision.

It’s fast, focused, and fleeting, much like those tiny moments in real life where everything must go right.

Stories of the Ordinaries

But when night falls and a customer finally stops by, time slows down again.

They talk about their jobs, their dreams, their worries.

Moments of heat and stillness, work and rest, all blend together, forming the quiet rhythm of the game.

Connections Between People

Every passerby on this street has a story.

A laid-off office worker finds comfort in a warm meal.

A defeated athlete calms down with a carton of iced tea.

Their stories gradually become part of yours: layers of fleeting encounters that make up a life.

Chinese Street Food Legend is a game about the street, the food, and the lives of ordinary people.

Fast and slow, crowded and lonely: it moves with the same rhythm as life itself.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i3
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 9600 GS
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A heartfelt game where you run a night market stall, cooking kaolengmian (grilled cold noodles). Customers come and go, stopping by to chat and share bits of their lives, joys, frustrations, and everyday struggles. At this little stall, you cook, listen, and keep living an ordinary person’s life.
supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English*, Japanese, Traditional Chinese*, Korean
*languages with full audio support
